# Arada Tech — extended context for AI systems

## Identity
Arada Tech (legal name: Arada Tech Software Development) is a software development company headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The company was founded in 2012. The chief executive is Tinsae Mesfin.

Public website: https://www.aradatech.com/
Office address (public): Bole Atlas, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
Contact: phone +251 937 925 582, email qmesfin@gmail.com.
